SUMMARY: 🥾 Trail Time | Fall Colors Finale🍁 🏁 | 🦃Turkey Trot w/Brenda
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
🥾 **Trail Time \| Fall Colors** 🍁🍂 is a volunteer-led, biweekly hiking series to stay active, explore Colorado, and connect with fellow hikers! Hikes range from Easy to Hard.

**✨ We create the space — you bring the energy!** Come solo or bring friends, and get ready to **hike, explore, and connect!** 🙌

👥 **Limited spots!** Please update your RSVP early if plans change. **Reliable RSVPs get priority!** 😊

**📍 THIS WEEK'S HIKE: TURKEY TROT TRAIL**

**🥾 \~3.4 mi • ↗️ \~807 ft gain • 🔄 Loop • 💪 Easy/Moderate • 🕒 \~2 hrs**

**Let's burn some turkey calories! 🦃🔥** What better way to celebrate Thanksgiving weekend than with a Turkey Trot? Enjoy some fresh air, scenic trails, and a little post-feast exercise! 🥾🍁

🚗 **CARPOOLING** 🙌

📍 **Meet:** Green benches near Section DD at Wooly Mammoth Park & Ride (follow event pin).

🕗 **Meet:** 10 AM
🚙 **Depart:** 10:10 AM sharp
⛽ **Passengers:** Please chip in for gas!

**🥾 Boots hit the trail: 10:25 AM**
🐶 **Dogs:** Welcome!
🚻 **Restrooms:** Available

**🗺️ Route (AllTrails):**
🦃 [View Turkey Trot Trail ](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/us/colorado/turkey-trot-trail)

**📲 Navigation & Buddy System:** Download the AllTrails route for offline use. Hiking faster or slower than the group? Buddy up with someone at a similar pace and stick together when possible!

**☕️ OPTIONAL POST-HIKE TEA & HOT CHOCOLATE SOCIAL**

Stick around for warm drinks and good company! Bring your favorite mug and tea or hot cocoa mix. I’ll bring the hot water! 🫖

Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
Fewer cars on I-70, better conversation on the drive, and someone to ride the first chair with.

This is our standing ski and ride carpool. Epic and Ikon pass holders meet at the Wooly Mammoth Park-n-Ride, sort into cars by resort, and head up together. Skiers and snowboarders both welcome.
In winter, the drive is half the excitement! Ninety plus minutes in a car with good people beats ninety plus minutes alone with a traffic map.

📝 GAMEPLAN
6:00am: Meet at the Wooly Mammoth Park-n-Ride, I-70 & CO-58, Golden
6:00 to 6:15am: Sort into cars by pass and resort, load gear
6:15am: Cars roll. I-70 does not wait, so neither can we.
All day: Ski or ride with your car, or split off and meet back at an agreed time
4:30pm: Cars head back. Each car sets its own time before splitting up.

🚗 HOW THE CARS SORT
Epic cars: Breckenridge, Keystone, Vail
Ikon cars: Copper, Arapahoe Basin, Winter Park
Mixed cars: Keystone and A-Basin sit about ten minutes apart on US-6, so one car can drop at both.
Comment below with four things: Epic or Ikon, which resort, driving or riding, and open seats if you are driving.

⚠️ CARPOOL GROUND RULES
Riders split gas and parking with the driver. Settle up before the drive home so nobody has to chase anyone.
You ride home in the car you came up in. Agree on a meeting time and place before anyone clicks into a binding.

🚗 **Drivers:** AWD or 4WD with good (>3/16") tread, and mountain plus a snowflake or "M+S" or real snow tires are required to drive. Colorado's Traction Law is enforced on I-70, and one car stuck on a hill ruins the day for everyone in it and behind it. Drivers stay sober. Après is allowed, just not for the person holding the keys.
Several resort lots now require paid parking reservations on weekends and holidays. Drivers, check your resort's parking page before the day.

🎒 WHAT TO BRING
\* Pass, loaded and in your pocket
\* Helmet and goggles
\* Layers. The base area is a different climate than Golden.
\* Water and snacks for the car
\* A boot bag to keep your driver's car clean
\* Gas and parking money or venmo
\* Smiles: Definitely!

🤝 HOW WE RIDE
We ski and ride in crews at similar levels and regroup at the bottom of every lift, and for lunch if possible. Nobody goes into the trees or off-piste alone. If your crew goes into the trees, you stay with your buddies all the way down and keep each other in sight the whole time. No waiting at the bottom and finding out later that someone is upside down in a tree well.

If someone wants a mellower run, that is always a fine call, and ideally someone goes with them. Come as you are. This is a group for people who like moving outside and talking about real things, not a race.

💬 STAY CONNECTED
Join our WhatsApp to connect, share, and suggest events, or learn about or smaller group overnight ski trips: message an organizer to get the link. You must be in Colorado.

Event is cross posted here: [Mile High Adventures](https://www.meetup.com/milehighadventures/events/317249448/?utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=share-btn_savedevents_share_modal&utm_source=link&utm_version=v2&member_id=12116396)

📌 RSVP & ATTENDANCE
Seats are limited by cars. If you RSVP and show up late, expect to be possibly left behind as we don't wait.

SUMMARY: 🏓 Pickleball Social – All Levels Welcome! Make New Friends with Zhen !
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
Ready to swap the couch for the court and make some awesome new friends?
Whether you’re a total beginner who just bought a paddle, an intermediate looking for a regular crew, or a seasoned expert ready to show off your spin, **this is your spot.**

we’re gathering for casual, social, and fun pickleball. No pressure, no judgment—just good vibes and great games.

\#\#\# 📍 Where to Find Us

* **Location:** Southpark Pickleball Complex
* we usually meet on courts 18 and 19
* **Address:** 400 W County Line Road, Highlands Ranch, CO 80129 *(Easy to find on GPS)*
* **Exact Spot:** Look for Zhen and a group of friendly people holding paddles near the courts or under the shade structures! Read comments to see what courts we are on.
* Text Zhen @ +19706319482 if you have any questions

\#\#\# 🕒 When

* Come when you can, leave when you must.

\#\#\# 👟 What to Expect

* **19 Outdoor Courts:** Plenty of space to play. Courts 18 & 19 are drop-in play, stack paddle play
* **All Skill Levels Welcome:** We love mixing beginners and intermediates to keep it social, but we can also set up competitive games for the experts.
* **Open Rotation:** We’ll rotate players after games so everyone gets a chance to play and meet new people.
* **First-Come, First-Served:** The courts are public and unreserved, so flexibility is the name of the game!

\#\#\# 🎒 What to Bring

* [ ] **Your Paddle** (If you don't have one, message us—someone might have a spare! I usually have a spare)
* [ ] **Water / Hydration**
* [ ] **Sunscreen & Hat** (Safety first!)
* [ ] **A Good Attitude**
* [ ] **Snacks to Share with Friends and Socialize**

\> **⚠️ Quick Note:** There’s no official court sign-up needed—just show up! However, **please RSVP here** so we can track rough numbers and know how many courts to claim.

Got questions? Drop a comment or message Zhen directly. See you on the courts! 🏓☀️

SUMMARY: Running Group - Belleview Elementary School and Cherry Creek State Park
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
**When and where**
We **leave** the Belleview Elementary School parking lot at **5:45 PM**, so please try to arrive a few minutes before then. If you are running late or can't find us, leave a comment or send a DM!

**Pace and distance**
Our typical run is around 4.5 miles at a steady 9-11:00 minute/mile pace. However, this varies depending on who shows up!

**Group size**
We usually have around 5-10 people attend, depending on the weather and season. Many of us have been coming for years; some people come every week, while others come less frequently.

**About us**
This is a small, dedicated running group that's been meeting consistently for several years (formerly under Colorado Runs). We're a friendly, tight-knit group that welcomes new members who are looking to make friends, train for races, or find consistent running partners.

Come join us if this sounds like a good fit for your running goals! We look forward to meeting you!
